arguments.summary: Investigated the root cause of the p99 latency spike, confirmed the ingress idle timeout was the issue, and raised the timeout. The certificate alert was for the internal CA chain, which expired and was manually replaced. The cron job drift was due to the container running on UTC, and the schedule was in local time. The failed-jobs backlog was growing due to 47 malformed rows in the failed_jobs table, which have been deleted to unblock the retry queue. The failed_jobs table has been exported for the postmortem.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Monitor the retry queue to ensure jobs are processing correctly and address any ongoing issues with the failed_jobs backlog.
